name: 5-BT
summary: 5-Benzyloxytryptamine (5-BT), is a tryptamine derivative which acts as an agonist at the 5-HT1D, 5-HT2 and 5-HT6 serotonin receptors, and an antagonist of TRPM8.

pharmacology.text: 5-Benzyloxytryptamine (5-BT), is a tryptamine derivative which acts as an agonist at the 5-HT1D, 5-HT2 and 5-HT6 serotonin receptors, and an antagonist of TRPM8.

summaryZh: 5-苄氧基色胺是一種色胺衍生物，化學式為C17H18N2O，可作為多種5-HT2受體的激動劑和TRPM8的拮抗劑。

uses.en: It is a research compound used in laboratory studies of serotonin receptors and of the cold-sensing channel TRPM8.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用於血清素受體與冷感受通道TRPM8的實驗室研究。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用于血清素受体与冷感受信道TRPM8的实验室研究。

fact.en: As well as acting on serotonin receptors, it blocks TRPM8, the cold-sensing channel in nerve endings that menthol switches on, which is why mint feels cool.
fact.zh: 除了作用於血清素受體之外，它還會阻斷TRPM8；這是神經末梢上的冷感受通道，薄荷醇就是靠活化它讓人覺得涼，這也是薄荷給人清涼感的原因。
fact.zhHans: 除了作用于血清素受体之外，它还会阻断TRPM8；这是神经末梢上的冷感受信道，薄荷醇就是靠活化它让人觉得凉，这也是薄荷给人清凉感的原因。
